## scripting

| id | status | note | feature | our GUI | x3270 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| abort-script | deferred | Deferred with script-port (the user, 2026-11-17): this needs a GUI scripting interface, and that interface is deferred. | Abort running scripts, macros and strings | none: the GUI runs no scripts or macros for it to abort | File → Abort Scripts/Macros/Strings, sensitive while a task is active (x3270/menubar.c:1239-1245, :894-898; label x3270/fb-x3270:905); Abort() marks the running macro fatal (Common/task.c:4416-4430) |
| aid-wait | deferred | Deferred with script-port (the user, 2026-11-17): this needs a GUI scripting interface, and that interface is deferred. | An AID action in a script waits for the host to unlock (aidWait) | none: the GUI has no scripts; its keyboard is always the operator's | aidWait toggle, default true in x3270 (x3270/resources.c:395-396) and in s3270 (Common/glue.c:479): a scripted AID that locks the keyboard puts the task in TS_KBWAIT until it unlocks (Common/task.c:1630-1633, CKBWAIT at :265) |
| child-scripts | skipped | It runs arbitrary user programs, which the Mac sandbox restricts to files the user selects, and x3270's version also opens two loopback listeners (Common/childscript.c:1213-1237) that need network.server on the Mac (docs/releasing.md:693); a pipes-only version would avoid that, but either needs a store-probe check (docs/releasing.md:808); the cost is that keymap- and macro-launched helper scripts have no GUI equivalent. | Run a child script that drives the session (Script, CloseScript) | none | Script(program[,args]) action, from a keymap, a macro or another script, forks a child with X3270OUTPUT/X3270INPUT pipes, a loopback httpd URL and a script port in its environment, and locks the keyboard while it runs (Common/childscript.c:1128, :1312-1319, :1473); CloseScript ends the script's connection (Common/task.c:4036) |
| execute-shell | skipped | It is a child script running /bin/sh (Common/task.c:4067-4078), so it inherits child-scripts' loopback listeners (network.server on the Mac, docs/releasing.md:693) and needs a store-probe check (docs/releasing.md:808); the cost is losing keymap- and macro-bound shell commands, which the GUI has no action language to bind anyway. | Run a shell command from an action (Execute) | none | Execute(command) runs /bin/sh -c command as an unlocked child script (Common/task.c:4057-4078), bindable in keymaps and macros |
| httpd | skipped | Like the script port it is a listening server, and the Mac App Store build has network.client but not network.server (docs/releasing.md:693), so it needs a new entitlement plus a store-probe check under our rule (docs/releasing.md:808); the cost is losing HTTP/REST control of the GUI. | HTTP server for REST/JSON script commands | none | -httpd [addr:]port starts an HTTP server taking actions as /3270/rest/ text or JSON requests, with a small web page (x3270/x3270.c:170, :254; Common/httpd-core.c, httpd-nodes.c); httpd is an extended toggle, so Set(httpd,...) starts it at run time (Common/httpd-io.c:864) |
| keyboard-disable | deferred | Deferred with script-port (the user, 2026-11-17): this needs a GUI scripting interface, and that interface is deferred. | Disable the keyboard during a script, and re-enable it from the menu | none: nothing in the GUI disables the keyboard, since it runs no scripts | KeyboardDisable([true\|false\|ForceEnable]) (Common/task.c:4202-4224); Script() and Source() disable the keyboard implicitly (Common/childscript.c:1473, Common/source.c:247); File → Re-enable Keyboard, sensitive while it is disabled, runs KeyboardDisable(ForceEnable) (x3270/menubar.c:1231-1237, :886-890; label x3270/fb-x3270:913) |
| macros-menu | deferred | Deferred with script-port (the user, 2026-11-17): this needs a GUI scripting interface, and that interface is deferred. | Macros menu of named action sequences (macros resource, Macro action) | none | the macros resource, or macros.<host> per host, lists name: actions pairs (Common/task.c:400-425); x3270 shows them as a Macros menu while connected (x3270/menubar.c:1489-1545, label x3270/fb-x3270:972-973); Macro(name) runs one by name (Common/task.c:4228-4245) |
| prompt | skipped | It starts a terminal emulator and x3270if as child processes and talks to them over a script channel, none of which a store-sandboxed app may assume exists; the trade-off is losing an interactive action prompt, which an in-app console window could replace later. | The x3270> interactive prompt | none | File → x3270> Prompt (x3270/menubar.c:1208-1212, hidden under -secure; label x3270/fb-x3270:910) and Prompt() run x3270if -I in a console program found by the console resource, default none, i.e. a search for xterm and others (Common/childscript.c:1486-1515, x3270/resources.c:117-118) |
| script-cookie | deferred | Deferred with script-port, the channel it authenticates (the user, 2026-11-17: GUI scripting may be useful someday). | Security cookie for script connections (-cookiefile, Cookie) | none | -cookiefile path names a cookie file, read or created mode 0400 (x3270/x3270.c:162, :248; Common/cookiefile.c:84-165) and passed to child scripts (Common/childscript.c:1317-1319); a peer or httpd client must send Cookie(value) first, a wrong one is delayed (Common/task.c:4590-4630) |
| script-messages | deferred | Deferred with script-port (the user, 2026-11-17): this needs a GUI scripting interface, and that interface is deferred. | Script output, failure and message actions (Echo, Fail, Info, ignore) | none: no action language reaches the GUI, so no Info popup or ignore binding | Echo(text) writes to the script's output (Common/task.c:543-555); Fail([text\|-Async]) fails the script with a message (Common/task.c:570); Info(text) pops up an informational message, from a keymap or macro too (Common/task.c:509-517); ignore() does nothing, for binding a key to nothing (Common/task.c:520-524) |

When it is built, a listening control port needs network.server on the Mac (docs/releasing.md:693) and a store-probe check (docs/releasing.md:808). | Listen for script connections on a TCP port or a Unix socket (peer scripts) | none | -scriptport [addr:]port listens for s3270-protocol peers, -scriptportonce accepts one then exits, -socket listens on /tmp/x3sck.<pid> (x3270/x3270.c:201-203, :288-291; Common/task.c:906-944); scriptPort is also an extended toggle, so Set(scriptPort,...) opens one at run time (Common/task.c:656); clients are typically x3270if |

| script-screen-read | deferred | Deferred with script-port (the user, 2026-11-17): this needs a GUI scripting interface, and that interface is deferred. | Read the screen, fields, buffer and NVT text from a script | none | Ascii/Ebcdic with (), (len) from the cursor, (row,col,len) or (row,col,rows,cols), 0-origin, Ascii1/Ebcdic1 1-origin, AsciiField/EbcdicField the cursor's field (Common/task.c:2739-2785); ReadBuffer([Ascii\|Ebcdic\|Unicode\|Field]) dumps the buffer with attributes (Common/task.c:3087); Snap() saves a snapshot and Snap(Status\|Rows\|Cols\|Ascii\|Ascii1\|Ebcdic\|Ebcdic1\|ReadBuffer) reads it and Snap(Wait,...) waits for output and saves (Common/task.c:3340-3480); NvtText/AnsiText return buffered NVT-mode text (Common/task.c:3987); all reachable only from scripts and macros |
